name: llm-response-hygiene
description: Detect provider-specific MALFORMED LLM responses (DeepSeek DSML/XML text-mode tool-call markup, markdown tool_call fences, continuation-intent prose) and return the cleaned text. Pure function: no I/O, no network, no LLM call. Backs the omniagent core setting `malformed_response_tool` (empty default = core keeps its built-in provider-neutral heuristic).
